lines.en: As I walk, bark creaks.

lines.zh: 我的身体是一整截树干。
lines.en: My body is a length of trunk.

lines.zh: 木头腿，一步一步沉下去。
lines.en: Wooden legs, one heavy step at a time.

lines.zh: 林子里，我走得比谁都稳。
lines.en: In the wood I walk surer than anyone.

lines.zh: 我的树枝撑开，占了两格。
lines.en: My branches spread two blocks.

lines.zh: 我绕过小树，不压到它们。
lines.en: I go around saplings so they aren't crushed.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边掉树皮屑。
lines.en: Bark flakes fall as I go.
I move slowly through the flower forest.

lines.zh: 我脚下的土，被踩得很实。
lines.en: The soil packs firm under me.
When I walk, the birds go quiet.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边听根的声音。
lines.en: I walk and listen to the roots.

lines.zh: 我朝林子深处去，那里安静。
lines.en: I head deeper. It's quiet there.

lines.zh: 站着，像一棵老树，皮都硬了。
lines.en: Standing like an old tree, bark gone hard.
I'm listening to water underground.

lines.zh: 我身上有苔藓，长在缝隙里。
lines.en: Moss grows in my cracks.

lines.zh: 我不用吃太多，喝点水就够。
lines.en: I don't eat much. A little water does.
The wind moves my branches.
I wait for something in the soil.
The light here is sifted by leaves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张开枝，收一点光。
lines.en: I spread my branches to catch light.
There's nothing I need to do.

lines.zh: 我站着，鸟会落在我肩上。
lines.en: I stand, and birds land on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的年轮，比这片林还老。
lines.en: My rings are older than this wood.
I settle my roots deeper.
This quiet suits me.
I'm waiting for footsteps.

lines.zh: 你走得太重了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy. I hear them.
I lower my head; the bark creaks.
Are you here to cut trees?
I don't like the sound of axes.

lines.zh: 我的树皮上落了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust lies on my bark.
There is pine resin on your axe blade.
Step back and I won't move.

lines.zh: 我这么大，你也不好下斧。
lines.en: I'm big. Hard to find a place to cut.

lines.zh: 我这里的树，都比你的工具老。
lines.en: The trees here are older than your tools.

lines.zh: 你的掌心有砍树磨出的茧。
lines.en: There are axe calluses on your palms.
If you swing, I won't stand still.
I draw my branches in to guard myself.
This wood will remember you.
Walk away and I'll forget.

lines.zh: 我的年轮，一圈圈数不清。
lines.en: My rings are too many to count.

lines.zh: 你身上没有年轮的味道。
lines.en: You carry no smell of growth rings.
A piece of bark fell off. No matter.
That cut my branch.

lines.zh: 一块树皮从我身上剥落。
lines.en: A strip of bark peels off me.
I don't cry out. My leaves shiver.

lines.zh: 里面是软的，可我不说在哪。
lines.en: There's softness inside. I won't say where.
That slowed me.
I draw my branches in to guard.
Wood splinters all over the ground.
I can stand. My roots hold.
The wood remembers that.
Water? That I do need.
I extend a branch and test it.
Not edible. I push it aside.
Set the water down and I'll drink slowly.
Only a little. I won't ask for more.
I don't know that smell.
I look, then close my branches.
Keep it. The soil has plenty.
Done drinking. I settle.
What I want is water, not this.
The smell of water comes from your side.

lines.zh: 你要是想给我，就放在地上。
lines.en: If it's for me, put it on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的树皮蹭掉了你一层皮。
lines.en: My bark scraped a layer off you.
I'm a trunk. Can't be shoved.
I shift my branches aside a little.
A piece of bark fell off.
I'm wide. I take the path anyway.
There's bark dust on your hands.
That shook leaves to the ground.
I hold. Not a hair moved.

lines.zh: 别站在我枝下，会掉东西。
lines.en: Don't stand under my branches. Things fall.

lines.zh: 我的枝杈挂住了你的袖子。
lines.en: My branch has snagged your sleeve.
My kind talk through roots.

lines.zh: 我把根伸过去，碰到了它。
lines.en: I reach a root over and touch it.

lines.zh: 两截树干站在一起，很配。
lines.en: Two trunks side by side. Fitting.
We share the water underground.
Neither speaks. The roots move.
The soil remembers this.

lines.zh: 叶子在我们头上落下来。
lines.en: Leaves fall over both of us.
At dawn we settle our own roots.
Its rings are a few short of mine.
I remember which way its roots run.
I pinch it with a branch. Slowly.

lines.zh: 这块石头，我用根卷起来。
lines.en: I roll this stone up with a root.

lines.zh: 我这棵会走的树，根还在。
lines.en: A walking tree, roots and all.
I sniff. Rain.

lines.zh: 我用枝夹起来，很慢，这段木头我认得。
lines.en: My branches lift it slowly; I know this wood.
This wood I know.

lines.zh: 我用枝尖拨开一层腐叶。
lines.en: I part the rotting leaves with a branch tip.
This can be planted. Let me try.
I coil my roots around it.
Mostly soil on the ground.
You've taken out an axe.

lines.zh: 我把枝张开了，护住自己。
lines.en: I spread my branches to guard myself.
I keep this wood.

lines.zh: 我这身体，比木头还难砍。
lines.en: This body is harder to cut than wood.
This bark of mine is harder than branch.
Step back and I won't act.

lines.zh: 我把根从土里拔出来一点。
lines.en: I pull my roots partway out.

lines.zh: 这片林子的叶子在发抖。
lines.en: The leaves of this wood are trembling.
My leaves rustle loudly.
Where you stand is my root.

lines.zh: 我听见钢铁出鞘的声音。
lines.en: I hear steel leaving its sheath.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢动，可不是不能。
lines.en: I dislike moving. Not that I can't.

lines.zh: 我一直朝着你，枝也没收。
lines.en: I face you. Branches still open.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就把枝拨过去。
lines.en: You go left; my branch swings that way.

lines.zh: 我数着落叶落下的间隔。
lines.en: I count the gaps between falling leaves.
Fallen leaves cover your footprints.
My roots follow under the soil.
My branches have closed the way.

lines.zh: 我把身体转过来，很费劲。
lines.en: I turn my body. Hard work.

lines.zh: 风把我的叶子吹得乱翻。
lines.en: The wind turns my leaves over and over.
My branch tips sway before your eyes.
I know this ground better than anyone.
Back to the treeline and there's nowhere.

lines.zh: 我的根在土里悄悄伸过去。
lines.en: My roots reach through the soil, quietly.
My branch lashes out. Heavy.

lines.zh: 这一下，把落叶都卷起来。
lines.en: That swept up all the leaves.

lines.zh: 一股风卷过去，带着叶子。
lines.en: A whirl of wind, leaves in it.
I whip a root out of the soil.
It landed, and I'm slower for it.
My branch sweeps at the back of your knee.
I'd rather not use this.
You retreat; I draw my branch back.

lines.zh: 这一下，把地面的土翻起来了。
lines.en: That turned the soil up.
I stand. Leaves are still falling.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替这片林子打的。
lines.en: That was for this wood.

lines.zh: 我的枝抽在你肩上，很沉。
lines.en: My branch lands on your shoulder, heavy.
I rise out of the soil. Slowly.
Wet soil still on my bark.

lines.zh: 这里的树，比我记得的矮。
lines.en: The trees here are shorter than I remember.
I open my branches one by one.

lines.zh: 有鸟落在我肩上，很快又飞走。
lines.en: A bird lands on me and leaves.
This wood is very quiet.
I test my roots. Firm.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着去年的叶子。
lines.en: Last year's leaves still hang on me.

lines.zh: 我不需要别的，土就够了。
lines.en: I need nothing but soil.
I settle and stop moving.
My roots have taken in new soil.
I have a share of this wood.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的树皮就焦了。
lines.en: Fire chars my bark.
I fall and two branches snap.
Soaked, my roots begin to rot.
The blast tears my branches open.
It drives deep into my trunk.
Light binds me and my branches won't open.
The soil dried and my leaves curl.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整棵树都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole trunk lights up.

lines.zh: 下面没有土，我掉了下去。
lines.en: No soil below. I fall.
